terms.title: Promoter Terms of Service
terms.description: Please review the promoter program terms.
terms.scrollToAccept: Scroll through all terms to enable acceptance.

eligibility.title: Eligibility and enrollment
eligibility.body: You must use your own Wat2Do account, keep a school on your profile, provide an email that can receive Interac e-Transfers, and accept the promoter terms when you enroll. Enrollment does not guarantee future poster availability.

posters.title: Official posters and placements
posters.body: Use only the approved files generated by Wat2Do. Each unique QR belongs to one physical placement. Do not duplicate a QR across locations, move it to another placement, or reuse it for another poster.

scans.title: Activation and qualifying scans
scans.body: The first scan establishes the poster placement as the Activation scan and is not payable. A visitor must remain on Wat2Do for at least {{seconds}} seconds before a scan can qualify. Duplicate, unconfirmed, automated, manipulated, and fraudulent scans do not qualify. Wat2Do may review unusual traffic before releasing a payout.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Each qualifying scan earns {{rate}}. The eligible balance for the prior UTC calendar month is paid by Interac e-Transfer on the {{payoutDay}} of the following month. Held amounts remain under review. Taxes and accurate payout details remain your responsibility.

disputes.title: Payout and scan disputes
disputes.body: If you believe a scan or payout was measured incorrectly, contact Wat2Do through the promoter Discord and include the poster, payout period, and relevant details. Wat2Do will review the program records and explain the outcome.

conduct.title: Safe and respectful placement
conduct.body: Place posters only where you have permission. Do not cover required notices, damage property, misrepresent Wat2Do, or place materials where campus or local rules prohibit them.

privacy.title: Privacy and measurement
privacy.body: Public poster areas appear only as approximate map cells. Wat2Do uses hashed visitor identifiers, does not store raw IP addresses, and keeps promoter identities, payout details, and exact placements private. Measurement is limited to confirming unique, valid visits and protecting the program from abuse.

changes.title: Program changes and suspension
changes.body: Wat2Do may pause new enrollment or poster creation, retire designs, update these terms, or suspend participation for abuse. Existing QR redirects and earned payout records remain available according to the program rules.
